title: Refresh /lookups/runbooks (Runbook notebooks by AppCI)
description: Daily refresh of the /lookups/runbooks table from Dynatrace notebooks, keyed by the leading 3-letter AppCI token. Counts notebooks whose name starts with a 3-letter AppCI token and contains the word "Runbook" (case-insensitive). Feeds the L3 "Runbooks Linked" scorecard check.

refresh_runbooks_lookup.name: refresh_runbooks_lookup
refresh_runbooks_lookup.description: List notebooks, match runbooks, aggregate appci->count, upload lookup table
